<function name="GetLaddersAtSide" parent="CNavArea" type="classfunc">
	<description>
Returns all <page>CNavLadder</page>s that have a ( one or two way ) connection **from** ( one and two way ) this <page>CNavArea</page> in given direction.

See <page>CNavArea:GetLadders</page> for a function that returns <page>CNavLadder</page> from/in all sides/directions.
	</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="navDir" type="number">The direction, in which to look for <page>CNavLadder</page>s.

0 = Up ( LadderDirectionType::LADDER_UP )
1 = Down ( LadderDirectionType::LADDER_DOWN )</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="table">The <page>CNavLadder</page>s that have a ( one or two way ) connection **from** this <page>CNavArea</page> in given direction.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
